about: Model-provider confinement falsifiers (cc-model-confine lane, tasks 006, 004, 011, 013 and 010). Every entry but F-cc1e and F-cc8-rm-journal edits capsules/model-provider/confine.sb, which sandbox-exec reads at each launch, so a mutated profile needs no rebuild. F-cc1e and F-cc8-rm-journal edit capsules/model-provider/tests/confine/main.rs, so the runner rebuilds the test for them; the runner's startup recovery restores that file after a killed run. F-cc1a turns (deny default) into (allow default) and F-cc1b widens the journal read/write grant from STORAGE_ROOT to STORAGE_PARENT; model_outside_write_denied then fails because the redirected journal write succeeds. F-cc1c widens the STORAGE_PARENT read from the parent alone to its subtree; model_outside_read_denied then fails because the run record outside STORAGE_ROOT is read and returned. F-cc1d leaves the STORAGE_ROOT grant write-only; model_outside_read_denied then fails at its first init, which cannot inspect the journal root. F-cc1e removes that test's one fixture rule from capsules/model-provider/tests/confine/main.rs, so the runner rebuilds the test; runs_get then stops at the record's existence check instead of its open, and the test fails. Each F-cc1-rm entry removes one allow rule and model_provider_ops_under_profile fails. F-cc7a turns (deny default) into (allow default) and F-cc7b keeps (deny default) and adds one (allow file-read*) after the last rule; model_local_offer_fails_closed_under_profile then fails because the init with a local engine offer answers ok. F-cc8a turns (deny default) into (allow default); model_outside_create_reports_access_denied then fails because the redirected init answers ok. F-cc8c keeps (deny default) and adds one (allow file-write* (subpath (param "STORAGE_PARENT"))) after the STORAGE_ROOT rule; the redirected journal create then succeeds, runs/ appears under the outside sibling, and the same test fails because init no longer answers journal_access_denied. F-cc8-rm-journal removes that test's one fixture rule, a metadata read of the redirected journal root, from capsules/model-provider/tests/confine/main.rs; the sandbox then refuses the inspect before the create, init answers journal_corrupt, and the test fails. F-cc10a turns (deny default) into (allow default) and removes (deny network*), because (allow default) alone leaves (deny network*) refusing the connect; F-cc10b keeps (deny default) and turns (deny network*) into (allow network*); model_hosted_run_fails_closed_under_profile then fails because the hosted run's request reaches the test's Runtime socket stand-in. Removing (deny network*) alone changes no behaviour, because (deny default) still refuses the connect, so that removal is held by the shared contract check in the wallet crate, which a provider-command list cannot run. The confined tests need /usr/bin/sandbox-exec and skip without it, so this list is a Mac gate. Files are relative to examples/agent-host.
